label: ExerciseBP - Has the participant had their hip replaced - Insight Phase 2
meta_rows: ExerciseBP - Has the participant had their hip replaced - Insight Phase 2
Exercise blood pressure and stepper test from the Insight phase 2 sweep (2018-2021).
cat_rows: This category contains information on the six-minute self-paced stepper test. This is administered to assess the participants exercise capacity and the effects of exercise on physiological measures including blood pressure and heart rate.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
